ownerRule: Hero authors write only their src/hero-packs/<name>.js, qa/cohort/<name>.test.mjs and asset source manifest. Only integrator changes engine, registry, app, build and active roster.

exports.definition: runtime hero object: stable internal id, registryNumericId, valveHeroId, name/en/role/color, explicit arena hp/combatHp/attack/move_speed/attack_range/attack_interval_s/mana_regen, portrait/render paths, exactly4 abilities. Each ability has id=official key, valveAbilityId, slot, official source/profile, mvp fields and explicit arenaNote.
exports.contract: selected four ability IDs, automatic innate IDs, explicitly omitted IDs, level18/base-no-item profile, formula/source mapping, geometry, death/dispel/reflect/break behavior and adaptation notes.
exports.sharedSystem: Actual core4 packages export sharedSystem:CohortCombat; all four share one integrated engine adapter. Package definition is loaded via CORE4_PACKS by runtime-heroes. New independent systems require integrator wiring; this is not a drop-in plugin loader.

hooks.init(e): Once per round. Initialize plain serializable fighter.pack and engine.packState when a core4 hero participates.
hooks.cast(e,f,slot,options): Return boolean for owned ability; undefined delegates legacy.
hooks.activate(e,f,cast): Return true for owned effect; false delegates legacy.
hooks.attack(e,f,target,damage,m): Return modified basic damage; may annotate m and charge per-attack mana.
hooks.beforeDamage(e,event): After baseline mitigation/block before health debit; change event.damage. Event contains attacker,target,m,info,guard.
hooks.afterDamage(e,event): Event damage is actual HP debit; reflection flags prevent recursion.
hooks.dispel(e,f,tier): Remove statuses according to basic/strong/none tier.
hooks.moveMultiplier(e,f): Return multiplier relative to existing movement modifier.
hooks.movingAttack(e,f): Allow only committed attack recovery during live link; simulation timestamp independent of visual animation. Clear on hurt/control/skill/death.
hooks.tick(e,dt): Once per fixed step before fighter updates; process world and fighter state.
hooks.endStep(e): Idempotent owner death cleanup before KO resolution.
hooks.broken(f): Whether live Viper Strike disables passives.

rendering: Use src/hero-packs render metadata and assets/cohort/<hero> sheet. 4 poses idle/attack/guard/jump with transparent background; source image pixel review required. No core renderer edits by package authors.
status: Core4 implemented adapter ABI; source of truth src/cohort-combat.js and engine call sites. Independent future systems must be integrated and tested explicitly.

stateSemantics.debuffPierces: Store boolean on persistent debuffs. Nonpiercing move/attack/negative-stat effects are suppressed while target has debuffImmune; keep expiry advancing for restoration after immunity.
